title: Robots Need More than VLA and World Models
author: Elis Karcini; Faisal Mehrban; Quang Nguyen; Mac Schwager; Arash Ajoudani; Cesar Cadena; Jan Peters; Marco Hutter; Haitham Bou-Ammar
summary: Robots learn better by combining different types of data, like videos, actions, and simulations. Each data source shows part of the robot’s world, so merging them helps build a full picture. This approach improves robot control and task understanding.
